text:
alex: quick handoff — I'm oncall until 09:30 PT. Postmortem remediations status:
- RED-4523 (cache key normalization): rolled to prod at 03:12, metrics look good.
- RED-4524 (retry storm mitigation): PR is merged to staging, awaiting canary in prod.
- RED-4525 (alert tuning): done, alert thresholds lowered and annotated.

maria: thanks. for RED-4523 can you paste the query you used to validate error-rate? want to add to the runbook.

alex: sure, ran a short time-window agg against metrics:
```
SELECT count(*) as errors, avg(latency) as p99
FROM request_events
WHERE service = 'inference' AND timestamp > now() - interval '15 minutes'
GROUP BY result_type;
```
errors are at ~0.02% after the deploy. p99 improved by ~120ms.

sanjeev: I kicked off a smoke run across the critical routes after the deploy — no anomalies. Also validated kv-cache hit ratio increased (local telemetry)

ops-bot: deploy-redwood/4523 succeeded — rollout 100% to prod — timestamp 2026-03-16T03:12:08Z

maria: awesome. two quick asks:
1) can someone confirm A/B fallback still works end-to-end? (RED-4524 is related so want to be safe)
2) add the above query to the postmortem notes and link the dashboard panel.

sanjeev: confirmed fallback exercised manually via the feature-flag toggles. traffic routed to fallback model within ~180ms as expected.

elaine: small FYI — I noticed a minor uptick in 5xx traces from a sub-route yesterday evening. traced to an upstream NLB timeout; postmortem item RED-4530 exists. not blocking but wanted to flag risk for next 24h while we watch cache warm.

alex: noted. I'll keep an eye on RED-4530 metrics overnight. if anything >0.1% for 5xx on that sub-route, reopen a bridge.

maria: tagging runbook owners @sanjeev and @elaine to update entries. also scheduling a quick async check-in at 10:00 PT to confirm no regressions after traffic spike window.

sanjeev: I'll update the runbook section for the fallback checklist and include the SQL and the dashboard link.

elaine: 👍 also added a short note about NLB timeouts and the mitigation we used (connection backoff + increased idle timeout) to the remediation list.

alex: handoff complete. oncall next is @maria — she confirmed she can take over at 09:30 PT. if anything pops up, ping #eng-oncall and I can jump back on.

maria: confirmed, taking over at 09:30 PT. thanks team. :raised_hands:

sanjeev: quick reminder — if we see a recurring pattern, we should consider a canary with the retry-limiter enabled earlier in the path. flagged RED-4526.

elaine: good call, added RED-4526 to the backlog and linked to the postmortem.

alex: final note — leaving the canary window open until 11:00 PT. will post any anomalies here. good handoff everyone.
__notes: Slack thread: oncall handoff + postmortem follow-ups; short, realistic messages with code block and bot notice. No title field per agents.md.
